findingDetails.title: Central bypass-switch reference (.env.example) omits the two validation switches
findingDetails.evidence: The git-hook bypass family (SPECKIT_SKIP_COMMIT_MSG_VALIDATE, SPECKIT_SKIP_ROUTE_REMINT, SPECKIT_SKIP_PREPUSH_SKILL_GATE, SPECKIT_SKIP_PREPUSH_TRACK_GATE) is documented there; a repo-wide search finds zero SPECKIT_SKIP_VALIDATION/SKDOC_SKIP_VALIDATION lines in .env.example (positive control: same pattern matches validate.sh:75,125,129).
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the two switch lines to .env.example §16 beside the other bypasses, or record the omission as intentional.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Repo-wide rg sweep for the switch names; the only production-path hits are the example file (commented) and tests, confirming the switches are unset by default.
